responsibility: Turn one request to review a skill into a bounded review-intake record.
primary_output: One review-intake record with supplied facts, missing evidence, permitted actions and the next reviewer handoff.
target_user: An agent preparing a skill review for a maintainer.
profile: Portable standalone package; host interface and icons are optional.
exclusions: Migrating, overwriting or deleting a skill
Researching or performing an unrelated domain procedure
